_note: EXAMPLE restaurant-only manifest: schema-valid, FK-resolving, bilingual (EN/AR). 'restaurant-only' is NOT a valid identity.type (Zod enum backend/src/api/tenant-import.js:15 + D1 CHECK backend/migrations/0001_core.sql:19) so identity uses type 'other' + businessType 'restaurant-only'; the restaurant core is menu+posUsers while rooms (dining cabins) + ratePlans (weekend/friday pricing) keep the file schema-complete. every meal resolves via categoryName against this file's own menu.categories[] — the direct mealCategoryId path is deliberately NOT demonstrated here because these files use identity/create mode, where the handler MINTS each category id as mcat_<uuid12> at import time, so no manifest can name one. The direct path is only usable in existing-tenant mode against a category that tenant already owns, and it is UNVALIDATED: a dangling id violates meals.meal_category_id (NOT NULL + FK) and fails the meals batch as a raw 500, not a silent null. categoryId/storeId placeholders must match the target tenant or be omitted for handler fallbacks (storeId then falls back to the org's first store). campId is omitted throughout: these files use identity/create mode, which mints a random project id that no manifest can name, and an unresolvable campId is now rejected with a 400 before a single row is written -- set it only to a project the target tenant already owns. Passwords are example-only.
